example.title: The Life of David
example.text: "The Lord does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart." — 1 Samuel 16:7
example.explanation: David, the shepherd who became king, symbolizes the journey of someone chosen not by appearance or status, but by heart. His story teaches us about courage against giants, genuine repentance, and the relentless pursuit of God's presence.
